remarks: Rarely available in guard-gated Bainbridge, 48 Parkcrest is a beautifully renovated 5-bedroom residence offering privacy, comfort, and effortless Southern California living. Extensively updated in 2026, the home showcases a designer kitchen with new cabinetry, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Cove dishwasher, Wolf gas range, and a stunning matte Mykonos stone island, complemented by new engineered hardwood flooring, designer lighting, fresh interior paint, and numerous thoughtful upgrades throughout. A bright, flowing floor plan offers elegant living and dining spaces, a welcoming family room, and a spacious primary suite with dual vanities, soaking tub, separate shower, and walk-in closet.
